title: Kobalos Linux Trojan Investigation Exercise
description:
Defence-oriented Scenario, Intermediate, Incident Response Profile
Investigate a Kobalos Linux trojan infection in a high-performance computing infrastructure.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a Kobalos Linux trojan infection in a high-performance computing infrastructure. The initial access was gained via SSH bruteforce, and the payload was dropped to /tmp/.installer. The malware communicates with the command and control server at 151.80.57.191:7070 every 120 seconds.

levels.title: Accessing the Sandbox
levels.cloud_content:
The sandbox consists of three hosts: c2-server, target, and next-target. Each host runs Ubuntu 20.04 LS and is connected via a network switch.
You will access the target host using SSH with the provided credentials.
levels.local_content:
Use the provided credentials to log into the target host via SSH.
Username: cyrano
Password: cyrano

levels.title: Identify Compromised Host
levels.content:
Check for the presence of the Kobalos payload (/tmp/.installer).
MISP Indicator: /tmp/.installer
levels.solution: Navigate to the target host and check if the file /tmp/.installer exists.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Check for unusual network connections or processes running on the compromised host.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Look for suspicious files in common malware drop locations, such as /tmp, /var/spool, and /root.

levels.title: Gather Evidence of Infection
levels.content:
Collect logs and configuration files that may contain indicators of compromise.
MISP Indicators: /var/log/auth.log, /var/log/syslog
levels.solution: Search for relevant log files, such as /var/log/auth.log or /var/log/syslog, and check for suspicious activity related to the Kobalos trojan.

levels.title: Determine the Scope of the Attack

levels.content:
Investigate reachable hosts from the compromised host and check for signs of lateral movement or additional infections.
